findings.text: 需离开工作电脑继续自己会话的开发者，可以在可信设备和非关键Host上先验证只读访问。
固定Noise IK核对远端身份，本地信任设备进入独立连接router，RPC白名单分发并可撤销断连。

ds-harness-remote提供Host插件及多端客户端，不能把Android/Web支持状态算作本轮独立验收。

#### 成本

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 首次 | Host/客户端及服务资源，量未知 | 配对、权限与Host用户核对 | Linux安装器root风险 |
| 持续 | 在线、电力、网络、中继和模型费用未知 | 凭据与版本维护 | 不只一次连接成本 |
| 恢复退出 | 重复调用可能有副作用 | 先核对结果、撤销设备及停服务 | 已执行命令不可撤回 |
[Q04](#research-q04) 使用自己的可信设备和非关键Host，先验证只读会话，确认Host用户及身份后才考虑最小写操作；终端关闭直到明确权限。断线时先查实际状态，结果不明不重发；撤销设备后回本机处理。

#### 效果

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 身份接线 | Noise远端key与本地设备信任 | 完整注册/密钥生命周期安全 |
| 隔离 | 每连接router及终端owner/attachment | 全Host授权与断线副作用 |
| 接续 | 复用原Host环境 | 弱网成功率、节时和费用 |
[Q03](#research-q03)owner配合claim对象避免旧清理释放新终端，值得迁移；[Q02](#research-q02)finally释放并发计数和撤销关闭流减少状态残留。移植必须保留设备可信来源和Host操作权限，单纯复制加密包装无助于最小权限。
[Q01](#research-q01) 相对远程桌面或手工隧道，把原生会话和工作区访问与多端传输回退集中起来；[Q02](#research-q02)与[Q03](#research-q03)显示身份、连接和终端所有权有独立机制，不能把标准Noise算法算原创。
[Q03](#research-q03) 显示加密不减少受信任设备已有的系统命令权限，Linux安装器还以root运行；[Q04](#research-q04)说明重连不是写入恰好一次。安全采用必须核对Host账户、设备信任和未知操作结果。
[Q05](#research-q05) 提出按业务操作ID先查询再决定重试的未验证方案，先核对现有Host是否已有实现，再用断线点对照评估重复副作用；不能统一自动重放写调用。

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)以标准Noise与远程RPC为参照，novelty25%是组合适配；mechanism50%连接/设备/终端所有权分离；transferability50%机制可复用但依赖Host契约；simplification50%收拢多端访问但新增服务负担。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)相比回电脑或远程桌面，workflow50%改变跨端接续；delivery25%结果仍是原Host任务；reach50%手机可接入已有环境；economics25%仅有接线便利，持续在线/中继/维护未计量。

recommendation.reason: 确需离开工作电脑继续会话且能管理设备信任的开发者，可以先在非关键 Host 上试用只读访问。相比重建环境或手工隧道，它把原会话和多端连接串联起来，但端到端加密不限制已授权的主机权限。如果无法确认 Host 身份、写操作结果不明或终端权限不可控，应停止远程写入并回本机核对。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01)同环境跨设备接续有具体反复交接任务，取75%超过一般用途50%；真实需求持续性与独立用户证据未知，不足100%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)身份与RPC集中、[Q01](#research-q01)多端访问有机制增量超入口25%；弱网、现有远程桌面总成本对照及全权限仍未知，取50%不取75%。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02)核对远端key、本地信任、router和撤销，[Q03](#research-q03)核对终端owner，覆盖有限只读试用的主要机制；未完整审计注册/所有写权限且无运行，止于源码50%而非75%。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04)需要持续Host、服务和凭据管理，[Q03](#research-q03)root风险及未知写入恢复对完整用途是重要负担，取25%而非可直接认定恢复可行的50%；仍可关闭终端及撤销设备，不等于完全无退路0%。

## Connect once. Ready whenever you are. Continue using your DeepSeek Harness instance from a phone, computer, or browser. Return to the same Harness session from whichever device is with you. Harness keeps running on your work computer, with the same workspaces, tools, and project setup. DS Harness Remote is simply another window into that environment. The DeepSeek Harness desktop edition is supported. Install the latest release: `ds-harness-remote@0.5.20` ## Features - Access your local Harness instance remotely from the web, a PC, or a mobile device: DSH first, with Codex, Cursor, and Antigravity support too. - Use the native DeepSeek Harness interface without a separate desktop conversation UI. - Create workspaces, configure models, and switch conversation models with the same smooth workflow as local use. - Support DeepSeek Harness Desktop, ready to use after installation. - Run a terminal-only [dsh-TUI](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI) profile as a Host. - No public listening port or public IP is required on the Harness Host. Connect from anywhere with internet access over a bidirectional end-to-end encrypted channel. - Prefer P2P connections, use TURN relay nodes worldwide, and fall back to Server Relay when needed. - Access workspace files, read-only previews, remote terminals, and authorized local development-service previews through the native Harness sidebar. - CodeX and ACP terminals use the Host's default shell in the session directory and restore the terminal screen on reconnect. - Android keeps per-conversation drafts and reading positions, offers backend-separated search and local favorites. Conversation text is loaded from the connected Host. ## Contents - [Connect once. The installer never creates a Web service for it automatically | Several clients can connect to the same Host at once; RPC calls and streams are isolated per connection. ## Install ### DeepSeek Harness Desktop support Open **Extensions / Plugin management** in DeepSeek Harness Desktop, choose installation from npm, and enter this package: `ds-harness-remote@0.5.20` Restart Desktop afterward. The provider list is loaded dynamically; new Server integrations need no further plugin release. 3. The Host starts with control of the current computer enabled. Remote terminal access is also enabled by default; you can turn it off in the detailed Remote settings. 4. On another device, open the DeepSeek Harness desktop edition, Remote Web, or the Android client and sign in to the same account. 5.
